verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a document-storage platform could ship a first-party AI surface for asking questions of files, summarizing, or extracting content. The only AI-related item is a developer-docs line about building Copilot UX components with SPFx. That is a developer building block, not a documented, shipped feature that answers questions about stored files, summarizes them, or extracts from them. The remaining evidence covers REST, Graph and webhook APIs and general sentiment, none of it about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, the storage understands its contents — a first-party AI surface (ask questions of files, summarize, extract) shipped and documented, not just announced
